rows.s_sql:
SET	@prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_b_covid19(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	monthly varchar(2) NOT NULL,
  a08x_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a08x_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a08x_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  a084_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a084_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a084_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  a09x_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a09x_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a09x_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  a090_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a090_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  a090_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  jx_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  jx_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  jx_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  j101_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  j101_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  j101_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  j189_3 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  j189_2 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  j189_1 int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',

  PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,monthly),
	KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year,monthly),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (monthly)
	) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_b_covid19 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_b_covid19
(
SELECT
@id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,SUBSTR(yymm,5,2) mothly
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,a08x,0)) as a08x_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,a08x,0)) as a08x_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,a08x,0)) as a08x

,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,a084,0)) as a084_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,a084,0)) as a084_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,a084,0)) as a084

,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,a09x,0)) as a09x_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,a09x,0)) as a09x_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,a09x,0)) as a09x

,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,a090,0)) as a090_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,a090,0)) as a090_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,a090,0)) as a090

,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,jx,0)) as jx_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,jx,0)) as jx_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,jx,0)) as jx

,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,j101,0)) as j101_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,j101,0)) as j101_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,j101,0)) as j101

,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-2) ,j189,0)) as j189_2
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year-1) ,j189,0)) as j189_1
,SUM(IF(b_year IN(@b_year) ,j189,0)) as j189

FROM tmp_behavior_covid c INNER JOIN chospital h ON c.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c)
WHERE yymm BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-4,'10') AND  CONCAT(@b_year,'09') 
GROUP BY h.hoscode,SUBSTR(yymm,5,2)
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("a08x_3") "a08x_3" ,SUM("a08x_2") "a08x_2" ,SUM("a08x_1") "a08x_1" ,SUM("a084_3") "a084_3" ,SUM("a084_2") "a084_2" ,SUM("a084_1") "a084_1" ,SUM("a09x_3") "a09x_3" ,SUM("a09x_2") "a09x_2" ,SUM("a09x_1") "a09x_1" ,SUM("a090_3") "a090_3" ,SUM("a090_2") "a090_2" ,SUM("a090_1") "a090_1" ,SUM("jx_3") "jx_3" ,SUM("jx_2") "jx_2" ,SUM("jx_1") "jx_1" ,SUM("j101_3") "j101_3" ,SUM("j101_2") "j101_2" ,SUM("j101_1") "j101_1" ,SUM("j189_3") "j189_3" ,SUM("j189_2") "j189_2" ,SUM("j189_1") "j189_1"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
